understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid through all levels, modify the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to match each goal cell, and then step onto every matched goal to activate and complete it.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move cost one stamina, while reaching zero stamina consumed a life and reset stamina. Walls blocked movement and blocked directions had to be avoided. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles changed the corresponding piece attribute; matching a goal required all three attributes simultaneously before entering its cell. Completing all goals advanced the level, while losing all lives ended the game.
